events.name: Burnout Paradise
events.info: Five performers take the stage, four of them running on treadmills for the duration, driven by one relentless countdown. What begins as a simple wager between performer and audience spirals into a breathless battle against exhaustion, expectation and time itself. Part comedy, part endurance feat and part performance art, Burnout Paradise skewers the absurd pace of contemporary life with razor sharp wit and physical daring. The result is euphoric mayhem: a visceral, joyful celebration of our collective urge to keep going, no matter the cost.
